game.name: Dark Void (USA, Europe)
game.desc: In Dark Void, an action game for Xbox 360, you play as a cargo plane pilot. Unluckily, Will, that's his name, crashes in the Bermuda triangle and finds himself propelled into a parallel dimension: The Void. This place is populated by the Watchers, aliens determined to leave this void to conquer the planet. Our hero must save the Earth by standing in the way of these creatures.
